name: Focus
changes: A focus timer with a countdown ring, a log of finished sessions and your streak
description: Start a focus block, put the phone down, and get a nudge when it ends. Sessions and streak stay on this phone.
schema: CREATE TABLE sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))), label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Focus', minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, day TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (date('now', 'localtime')), at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (time('now', 'localtime')))
CREATE TABLE run (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ends TEXT, total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1500, label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Focus')

card.query: SELECT n, mins, CASE WHEN n = 0 THEN 'Start your first block today' WHEN n = 1 THEN '**1** block done today' ELSE '**' || n || '** blocks done today' END AS headline FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n, coalesce(sum(minutes), 0) AS mins FROM sessions WHERE day = date('now', 'localtime'))
card.chart: WITH RECURSIVE d(n) AS (SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT n - 1 FROM d WHERE n > 0) SELECT coalesce((SELECT sum(minutes) FROM sessions WHERE day = date('now', 'localtime', '-' || d.n || ' days')), 0) FROM d

widget.query: SELECT count(*) AS n, coalesce(sum(minutes), 0) AS mins FROM sessions WHERE day = date('now', 'localtime')
